text:
Katherine: Heads up — hit two annoying things while upgrading the py SDK in the sampleapp.
Katherine: 1) Autogenerated pydantic models use `typing.Union[str, None]` in a bunch of places which throws strict pyright errors in our CI (we run --strict). mypy tolerates it but pyright insists on Optional[] or `str | None` in py3.10+. 2) Async client retry path leaks an aiohttp session when a 401 triggers reauth -> you get `Unclosed client session` warnings after a few failed requests.
Katherine: Minimal repro for the typing issue:
```
from typing import AsyncIterator
from redwood.models import StreamingChunk

async def stream_tokens() -> AsyncIterator[StreamingChunk]:
    async for c in client.chat.stream(...):
        yield c
```
pyright output: `error: Expected 'AsyncIterator[StreamingChunk]' but got 'AsyncIterator[Union[StreamingChunk, None]]'` — seems the generator yield typing is wrapped in `Union[..., None]` from autogen.
Katherine: Repro for session leak (dev env):
```
async with AsyncClient() as c:
    for i in range(3):
        await c.chat.create(prompt='bad token')  # returns 401, retry kicks in
# observe "ResourceWarning: unclosed <aiohttp.ClientSession>"
```
Katherine: Anyone seen both before and have a short-term workaround? I'm blocked from landing the sampleapp CI otherwise.

Alex: Ack, thanks for the report. Can you open two issues (typing + session leak) with repros? Tagging @Priya and @Sam for SDK typing/runtime.

Priya: Very likely two separate root causes. For typing: autogen template is emitting `Union[T, None]` (older pattern) instead of `Optional[T]` or `T | None`. Pyright strict rules prefer Optional or native union. Short term workaround: add a stub patch in the sampleapp types or use a small post-gen script to replace `Union[Foo, None]` -> `Optional[Foo]` and add `from typing import Optional`.

Sam: I dug into the autogen codegen: we normalize nullable types to `Union[X, None]` in a single template helper. I can modify the helper to emit `Optional[X]` when target typing backend is "python_typing". Opening PR now.

Sam: PR #4523 created — changes generator to prefer `Optional[...]` and updates tests. Also adds a fix for streaming return annotation to always be `AsyncIterator[StreamingChunk]` (was accidentally `AsyncIterator[Union[StreamingChunk, None]]`).

Katherine: Awesome, thanks. Any ETA for a patch release? I can temporarily patch sampleapp to ignore the pyright errors but want a proper fix.

Priya: We'll cut a types-only patch release once Sam's PR lands and passes CI. ETA 24–48h. For the session leak: can you paste the stacktrace? My hunch: retry decorator constructs a new aiohttp ClientSession on reauth but doesn't close the old one when swapping.

Katherine: Paste of the warning (trimmed):
```
ResourceWarning: unclosed <aiohttp.ClientSession object at 0x7f8b2c>
  self._session = aiohttp.ClientSession()
```
Katherine: This happens after 2-3 sequential 401s in a row, so retries are common in our test harness.

Priya: Ok that's consistent. I'll add a guard to close the existing session before replacing it and add a regression test that triggers a 401 in the retry path.

Alex: FYI we should also add a note in the changelog about typing changes — some downstream users may have local pyright strict configs and will need the types-only patch.

devex-bot: linked issue #789 and PR #4523 (<https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/4523>)

Katherine: I applied the local `sed` fix as a temporary workaround and CI in sampleapp moved past the typing errors. Will rerun with Sam's PR once merged. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Priya: cc @eng-ml for awareness — autogen typing change might affect model stubs too.

Sam: landing PR after two approvals. I'll follow up with a patch release note and the patch tag.

Katherine: Closing the loop — both fixes in staging, sampleapp CI green on my branch after PR merge. Leaving this thread in case anyone else hits similar pyright strictness issues. :white_check_mark:
